shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Modal Text && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg --files -g '*lock*' -g 'tsconfig*' -g 'vite.config*' -g '"'!node_modules'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Modal Text && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg --files -g '*lock*' -g 'tsconfig*' -g 'vite.config*' -g '"'!node_modules'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md && rg -n 'withTableSorting|withTableSelection|"'^#.*Pagination|''^#.*Table|''^#.*Select'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md | head -35 && rg -o '.{0,60}(Magnifier|ArrowDownToLine|Plus|Sliders|Ellipsis|ChevronDown).{0,60}' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/icons@2.23.1 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg -n 'Magnifier|ArrowDownToLine|Plus|Sliders|Ellipsis|ChevronDown|Persons|CircleQuestion|ArrowUpRight|ArrowRightFromSquare|CircleCheck|Clock|Xmark|Gear|Moon|Sun' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js"
